import java.util.*;

title: Find All K-Distant Indices in an Array
approach_name: Collect indices near any key occurrence
notes:
Task: Solve Find All K-Distant Indices in an Array.
Idea: Return each index if a key occurrence exists within distance k.
Invariant: Return each index if a key occurrence exists within distance k.
Edge cases: Minimum inputs, boundaries, duplicate values, and no-match cases.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<Integer> findKDistantIndices(int[] nums,int key,int k){List<Integer> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){for(int j=Math.max(0,i-k);j<=Math.min(nums.length-1,i+k);j++)if(nums[j]==key){out.add(i);break;}}return out;} }
complexity_reason: Return each index if a key occurrence exists within distance k.
